messages.subject: permissioning problem with shiny-server
parts:
I'm running shiny-server open source on a virtual machine, having successfully followed the initial setup and navigated to the default server page from a remote browser on port 3838.

i've installed my own shiny app on the machine, but when I navigate to the port on which my app is running, I get an error from bash.  This error is reflected in its logfile:

su: ignore --preserve-environment, it's mutually exclusive to --login.

-bash: line 0: cd: /root/ShinyApps/myapp: Permission denied


here are the permissions for /root/ShinyApps/myApp directory:

drwxrwxrwx


this directory contains the shiny app, called myApp.R.  Its permissions:

-rwxrwxrwx


The VM has the following specifications:

os: CentOS Linux release 7.2.1511 (Core)
R version: 3.3.0
shiny version: 0.13.2
shiny-server version: v1.4.2.786

FWIW, my shiny-server.config file:

server {
  listen 4042;

  location / {  

     app_dir /root/ShinyApps/myApp;  

     log_dir /root/ShinyApps/log;

    directory_index on;
  }
}



I'm running as root (I know this is discouraged).

Any ideas as to what my problem is?  Thank you in advance.
